study type: Cost analysis of a randomized controlled trial
exposure: multitherapy antenatal education CTLB' (Complementary Therapies for Labour and Birth) Study programme
cohort: The participants were women undergoing labour and birth who received either the CTLB antenatal education program or standard care.
finding: The CTLB antenatal education programme leads to significant net cost savings to payers, ranging from $A659 to $A808 per woman, primarily due to reduced rates of caesarean section and subsequent lower use of hospital resources.
mod_finding: Significantly more women in the study group experienced a normal vaginal birth, and significantly fewer women experienced a caesarean section, which was identified as the main driver of cost savings.
